title: Use a function input
summary: Solidity: Use a function input. Call twice(7).
introduction: A parameter is an input value. Call twice(4) in Remix. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Use a function input with Solidity

blocks.text: Paste one contract into Remix and choose compiler 0.8.24 or later in the 0.8 series. Deploy only to Remix VM for practice. Call the function named in the lesson; shown results are return values.

blocks.title: Use a function input

blocks.text: The input n is 4. The function returns its product with 2.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Very large products can overflow and revert in Solidity 0.8.
